query: Given observed log checkpoint refresh denied expired token, show the bounded caller-to-emitter source paths.
contract: Preserve both already reconstructed same-emitter caller branches if they fit the existing budget after lossless duplicate metadata removal; no extra paths, roots, source changes or numeric budget increases.

layout_control.hypothesis: Same independent code and exact log in conventional nested layout; retain two caller entries only if lossless duplicate range metadata removal makes them fit. Flat layout is passing baseline, not claimed repaired.

additional_controls: single caller retains one existing path
three callers never invent extra paths or exceed unchanged budget
range annotations with conflicting metadata cannot merge
duplicate range strict subset preserves every field in richer retained range
source freshness/path IDs/uncertainty and source text unchanged by dedupe helper
pressure_log: checkpoint refresh denied because the access credential has expired before the audit service completed the refresh request
pressure_contract: Detailed exact event keeps raw reconstructable branches; compact may retain fewer if still truly over budget, but never invents a path or exceeds1500.
